source: NASA SVS 3821 Flat Map Ocean Current Flows with Sea Surface Temperatures (ECCO2 model)
projection: plate carree, lon -180..180 left to right, lat 90..-90 top to bottom (already shifted from the video's 0..360 layout)
layout: per frame: class plane (width*height bytes) then value plane (width*height bytes), frames in order
dates_note: Starts Jan 2005 (NASA: data 10 Jan 2005 to 1 Jan 2006). NASA gives no per-frame date list for this video, and the warm band moves steadily north across the 22 frames, so it likely spans roughly Jan to late summer 2005, not a full year. Treat time as 'frame 1 to 22, early to later 2005'.
note: Temperatures are read from flow-line colours via NASA's colour bar (0-30 C), so they are approximate, from a model (ECCO2), not direct measurements. Cells with no line pixels are filled from the nearest cell.
